backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, referral links, tasks, balances, and access control with admin‑restricted link creation and profile/wallet APIs.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files for quick reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind styles defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading Inter font and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling routing, theme setup, auth gating, and referral redirect mode.
frontend/src/app/auth/AuthGate.tsx: Wrapper that blocks access until Internet Identity is initialized and authenticated.
frontend/src/app/auth/SignInPanel.tsx: Sign‑in UI displaying an Internet Identity login button with loading states.
frontend/src/app/auth/SignOutButton.tsx: Sign‑out button that clears Internet Identity and React Query cache.
frontend/src/app/auth/useAuth.ts: Hook exposing authentication status, principal string, and backend actor.
frontend/src/app/auth/useIsAdmin.ts: Hook calling backend isAdmin to determine if the current user is an admin.
frontend/src/app/home/HomeSection.tsx: Home page showing active referral links, admin upload action, and navigation to tasks.
frontend/src/app/home/ReferralLinkCard.t: Card displaying a referral link with commission, timestamp, destination URL, and share/copy actions.
frontend/src/app/home/UploadReferralLink: Modal form for creating referral links with title, URL, optional commission, and submit handling using createReferralLink mutation.
frontend/src/app/home/useReferralLinks.t: Hooks for fetching and creating referral links via actor methods, with query invalidation.
Layout component providing main content area and bottom navigation bar with section switching.
frontend/src/app/navigation/useSectionRo: Manages navigation between app sections using URL hash and exposes a function to update it.
Profile page showing principal ID and editable user profile form with save functionality.
Hooks to fetch and update the current user's profile using actor methods with query invalidation.
frontend/src/app/referral/ReferralRedire: Handles referral redirect flow, showing loading/error states and redirecting to destination URL.
frontend/src/app/referral/useReferralRed: Processes referral parameters, tracks clicks, finds matching referral link, and returns redirect status.
frontend/src/app/tasks/AddTaskDialog.tsx: Modal dialog for admins to create tasks with title, description, optional reward, using addTask mutation.
frontend/src/app/tasks/TasksSection.tsx: Displays available tasks, admin task creation button, and loading/error states.
frontend/src/app/tasks/useAvailableTasks: Provides hooks to fetch available tasks and add new tasks via the actor, with query invalidation on updates.
frontend/src/app/utils/clipboard.ts: Utility to copy text to the clipboard with a fallback for older browsers.
frontend/src/app/utils/format.ts: Functions to format numeric amounts and timestamps into human-readable strings.
Parses share parameters from the URL hash into user and link title values.
frontend/src/app/utils/shareUrl.ts: Builds a shareable URL containing encoded user and link title parameters.
frontend/src/app/wallet/RequestPayoutDia: UI dialog that validates input and submits payout requests while displaying balance and UPI info.
frontend/src/app/wallet/useWallet.ts: Hooks to read wallet balance, retrieve stored wallet events, and request payouts with local event logging.
frontend/src/app/wallet/walletEventsStor: LocalStorage-backed store for wallet events with functions to load, add, and clear events.
frontend/src/app/wallet/WalletSection.ts: Displays wallet balance, earnings, transaction history, and opens the payout request dialog.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on identity, invalidating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity context and provider handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty file noting that queries are organized in feature-specific hooks.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point wiring React, QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and global styles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions to read, store, and clear URL and session parameters, supporting both query-string and hash-based routing. Also provides a helper to persist URL parameters and remove sensitive params from the hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, fonts, radii, shadows, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations. Defines extended theme settings and content scanning paths.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current features, architecture notes, and roles for a referral‑link web app. Tracks implemented requirements, versions, and admin‑only permissions.
